{{Quote|I've got a friend you might be interested in talking to, name's Gendra. Go by and say hi to him.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FYW" />}}
'''Gendra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] who lived on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he resided in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="SWG:FYW" /> He was a friend of [[Chalmun/Legends|Chalmun]], the owner of the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Spaceport Cantina]], and his employees [[Muna Skish]] and [[Lurval]].<ref name="SWG:C">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Trader|Crafting|Tatooine}}</ref> He was also acquainted with [[Trehla Keelo]].<ref name="SWG:FT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find Trehla|Tatooine}}</ref> Gendra was usually friendly with newcomers in Mos Eisley, particularly those not interested in combat and violence.<ref name="SWG:FYW" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Gendra accepted to help a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who arrived in Mos Eisley with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] from [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]].<ref name="SWG:FYW" /> The arrival of these spacers was in fact a good opportunity for Gendra to help Chalmun.<ref name="SWG:C" /><ref name="SWG:E">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Entertainer|Entertainment|Tatooine}}</ref> One of the spacer, a [[Merchant/Legends|trader]], was a skilled crafter who was eager to prepare [[Jerky/Legends|meat jerky]] and [[Spice tea/Legends|spiced tea]] for the customers of the cantina and also crafted new glassware.<ref name="SWG:C" /> Another spacer, an [[entertainer]], agreed with performing in the cantina, dancing and [[Musician/Legends|playing music]] for the patrons who where delighted by the shows.<ref name="SWG:E" /> Gendra was very pleased of the help provided by the spacers.<ref name="SWG:C" /><ref name="SWG:E" /> The Quarren even offered a [[XP-38 sport landspeeder|XP-38 landspeeder]] to one of them.<ref name="SWG:GS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Gendra's Speeder|Tatooine}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Gendra was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FYW" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Gendra was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
